title: `-j` should also set `--test-threads`
author: joshtriplett
body_preview: In 2018, someone asked for `cargo test -jN` to also set the number of threads used to run tests. In 2023, we closed that issue. https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo/issues/6265 .  We may have discussed this, but I can't seem to find any record of the discussion. I'd like to re-raise that item for consideration.
